items.title: Harry "Chicken" Oscar Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: I went to see Bob Gilbert... He said, you're one of the fellas I'm looking for... And they started the WPA band then with 18 men... Lewis Nelson and myself on trombone... Bob used to play down at Valentis on trumpet.

ctx.x: It's running again. I was going to ask a little more about your life, you know, when you played at these bands in Chicago and then when you went on from there, how you got back to New Orleans,

how long it was before you came back and so on. Well, I left here in 19, early part of 19. I was 18, yeah. And I left here, went to Chattanooga. Chattanooga, stayed there a while. I went to Cincinnati. From Cincinnati, I went to Florida, just a floating plaster there. I wasn't playing no instrument. Then I came back to Birmingham and the Dayton flood came through. That was in 19, the latter part of the spring of 18, I believe. And then I went to Dayton and nothing in Dayton. I went over to Chicago. That's where I…
Do you remember any other trombonists? Dooson you say?
